mentions.name: Kaien
mentions.description: An App Store mini-project (Kaien) that helps kids learn the alphabet with a maximally slow, relaxed interface, intentionally avoiding over-stimulating slot-machine-style UI and designed to be easy to put down.
mentions.problem: The author wanted a way for their kid to learn the alphabet without a UI that looks and behaves like a slot machine.
mentions.audience: Children learning the alphabet; built by the author for their kid
mentions.source_excerpt:
Here is my fun mini-project:

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kaien/id6759458971

I wanted a way for my kid to learn the alphabet, but without a UI that looks & behaves like a slot machine. It's all maximally slow, relaxed and designed to be easy to put down.
